en.headline: Lingnan University Students’ Union announces dissolution after 59 years
en.dek: The union said campus and external conditions had changed and it had taken the difficult decision to dissolve after a joint meeting, leaving only a handful of active student unions among the eight publicly funded…
body: The Lingnan University Students’ Union announced late on Thursday that it had decided to dissolve, ending nearly six decades of operation. In a statement posted on social media, the union said it had earlier convened a joint meeting that passed a resolution to disband.

The union, established in 1967, said it had long upheld mutual support among students, maintained contact with the university and worked to raise members’ awareness of social issues. It stated that campus and external conditions had changed in recent years and, after balancing various factors, it had made the difficult decision to dissolve.

With the announcement, only a small number of student unions among Hong Kong’s eight publicly funded universities remain in active operation. Lingnan University had previously described the students’ union as an external organisation registered under the Societies Ordinance and not authorised by the university to conduct activities on campus.

zh.headline: 嶺南大學學生會宣布解散 結束近59年運作
zh.dek: 學生會稱近年校園內外形勢出現變化，經聯席會議通過後作出解散的艱難決定，八大資助大學僅剩少數學生會仍在運作。
body: 嶺南大學學生會周四深夜在社交平台發表聲明，宣布解散，結束自1967年成立以來近59年的運作。聲明指學生會較早前召開聯席會議，通過解散決議案。
學生會表示，成立以來一直秉持同學之間團結互助精神，積極與校方保持聯繫，並致力關注社會議題，推廣會員對社會的意識與責任感。惟近年校園內外形勢都出現變化，在平衡各種因素下，作出解散的艱難決定。
隨着嶺大學生會解散，現時八所資助大學中僅餘少數學生會仍然運作。嶺大校方早前曾表明，學生會是根據《社團條例》註冊的外部組織，與校方並無隸屬關係，亦未獲授權在校內進行活動。
